item.title: iPhone Duo 溢价回落、机械臂版 HomeView 正在开发
item.guid: iPhone-Duo-溢价回落、机械臂版-HomeView-正在开发
item.description:
According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple is developing a high-end smart home screen equipped with a robotic arm, codenamed J595, planned for launch in 2027 or 2028. The device is expected to feature an approximately 9-inch screen, capable of 360-degree rotation, and will be able to identify speakers and automatically turn towards them; it will be positioned higher than the current HomeView, with its specific name yet to be determined. 据彭博社 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果正开发一款配备机械臂的高端智能家居屏幕，代号 J595，计划于 2027 年或 2028 年推出。该设备预计搭载约 9 英寸屏幕，可旋转 360 度，并能识别说话者、自动转向对应的人；它将定位高于现款 HomeView，具体名称尚未确定。

Regarding iPhone Duo, according to Beijing News Shell Finance, as of 7 PM on October 17, the secondary market premium for the black 512GB version on the Dewu platform was 3150 yuan, a drop of more than 50% from the previous night's 6469 yuan. Dealers interviewed by Jiemian News also stated that the premium for receiving goods has fallen. iPhone Duo 方面，据新京报贝壳财经，截至 10 月 17 日 19 时，得物平台黑色 512GB 版本的二级市场溢价为 3150 元，较前一晚的 6469 元回落超过五成。界面新闻采访的经销商也表示，收货溢价已有回落。

Initial inventory remains unclear. Mark Gurman stated on X on October 18 that Apple stores have not yet uniformly required turning away customers without appointments, and some stores are still verifying arrival quantities against pre-orders. iPhone Duo will officially go on sale on October 23. 首发库存仍不明确。Mark Gurman 10 月 18 日在 X 表示，苹果门店尚未统一要求劝退无预约顾客，部分门店仍在核对到货量与预订订单。iPhone Duo 将于 10 月 23 日正式发售。

item.title: 曝三星拟采用台积电 3nm 工艺，为英伟达定制 HBM
item.guid: 曝三星拟采用台积电-3nm-工艺，为英伟达定制-HBM
item.description:
According to industry sources cited by the Seoul Economic Daily on October 18, Nvidia is collaborating with Samsung and TSMC to design custom high-bandwidth memory (NVHBM), planning to use TSMC's 3nm process to manufacture the bottom logic chip. This chip is responsible for controlling memory signals and is a crucial component in determining data transfer speed. 据《首尔经济日报》10 月 18 日援引产业消息人士报道，英伟达正与三星、台积电共同设计定制高带宽内存 NVHBM，计划使用台积电 3nm 工艺制造底部的逻辑芯片。该芯片负责控制内存信号，是决定数据传输速度的重要部分。

The report states that this solution will move the memory controller, originally located on the GPU, to the bottom logic chip, freeing up more space on the GPU for computational circuits. Compared to standard HBM4E, the design goal is to increase bandwidth by up to 30% and reduce power consumption by 15%. 报道称，这一方案会把原本位于 GPU 上的内存控制器移到底部逻辑芯片，为 GPU 腾出更多空间放置计算电路。相较标准 HBM4E，设计目标是带宽最多提高 30%、功耗降低 15%。

The collaboration also involves production capacity: Samsung's existing bottom logic chip production lines are insufficient to meet all custom demands, and TSMC can supplement the supply. Samsung is also verifying a plan to produce NVHBM bottom logic chips using its own 2nm process; the report does not indicate that subsequent production will be exclusively with TSMC. 合作也涉及产能：三星现有底部逻辑芯片产线难以承接全部定制需求，台积电可补充供给。三星同时在验证自家 2nm 工艺生产 NVHBM 底部逻辑芯片的方案，报道并未将后续生产锁定为台积电独家。

item.title: 英伟达否认 RTX 5090 停产，称供应链仍受限制
item.guid: 英伟达否认-RTX-5090-停产，称供应链仍受限制
item.description:
Jeff Fisher, Senior Vice President of Nvidia's Personal Computing Business, denied rumors of the GeForce RTX 5090 being discontinued while attending the RTX Spark PC launch event in Taipei on October 16, stating that this flagship gaming graphics card remains an important part of the product line and Nvidia will continue to supply it. 英伟达个人计算业务高级副总裁 Jeff Fisher 于 10 月 16 日在台北出席 RTX Spark 电脑开售活动时，否认 GeForce RTX 5090 即将停产的传闻，表示这款旗舰游戏显卡仍是产品线的重要部分，英伟达将持续供货。

Fisher also admitted that there are current supply chain limitations. He said this is not a problem Nvidia faces alone, as the global industry is affected by supply tightness, and the team is working hard to bring products to market. Fisher 同时承认，当前供应链存在限制。他说，这并非英伟达单独面临的问题，全球行业都受到供应紧张影响，团队正努力把产品推向市场。

Regarding Nvidia's expansion in the AI field in recent years, Fisher emphasized the foundational role of the gaming business: the team spent years building the GeForce gaming ecosystem, from which CUDA developed, leading to accelerated computing and AI. He stated that the company remains committed to the gaming market. 对于英伟达近年在 AI 领域的扩张，Fisher 强调了游戏业务的基础地位：团队多年建立 GeForce 的游戏生态，由 GeForce 发展出 CUDA，再走向加速计算和 AI。他表示，公司仍对游戏市场保持承诺。

item.title: 蔚来联创：蔚来第三季度终端销量首次分别超过 BBA 三家厂商
item.guid: 蔚来联创：蔚来第三季度终端销量首次分别超过-BBA-三家厂商
item.description:
On October 17, William Li, co-founder and president of Nio, disclosed that according to Wilson's terminal sales data, Nio cumulatively sold 111,638 vehicles in the Chinese market in the third quarter, with quarterly sales surpassing Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and Audi, three German luxury manufacturers, for the first time. 10 月 17 日，蔚来联合创始人、总裁秦力洪披露，按威尔森终端销量数据，蔚来公司第三季度在中国市场累计销售 111638 辆，季度销量首次分别超过奔驰、宝马、奥迪三家德系豪华厂商。

Under the same statistical caliber, BMW (including MINI) sold 107,210 vehicles, Mercedes-Benz (including Maybach, smart) sold 99,592 vehicles, and Audi sold 94,597 vehicles. This comparison is between Nio's total sales and the respective sales of the three manufacturers. 同一统计口径下，宝马厂商（含 MINI）为 107210 辆，奔驰厂商（含迈巴赫、smart）为 99592 辆，奥迪厂商为 94597 辆。这里比较的是蔚来公司的合计销量与三家厂商各自的销量。

From a regional perspective, Nio's third-quarter sales exceeded those of the three BBA manufacturers in 8 provincial-level administrative regions and 40 cities; in 12 provincial-level administrative regions and 94 cities, it surpassed at least one of them. The aforementioned cities include Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Wuhan, as well as Shantou, Yichang, Hegang, and others. 从地域来看，蔚来公司在 8 个省级行政区、40 个城市的第三季度销量超过 BBA 三家厂商；在 12 个省级行政区、94 个城市，至少超过其中一家。上述城市既包括北上广深、成都、武汉，也包括汕头、宜昌、鹤岗等。

item.title: Anthropic 为芯片融资拟向黑石提供逾 10% 收益率
item.guid: Anthropic-为芯片融资拟向黑石提供逾-10%-收益率
item.description:
According to Reuters, citing the Financial Times, Anthropic is arranging financing for its latest chip deal and plans to offer Blackstone a yield of over 10%. The arrangement remains a proposed transaction. 据路透社援引英国《金融时报》报道，Anthropic 正就最新一笔芯片交易安排融资，并拟向黑石提供超过 10% 的收益率。相关安排仍是拟议交易。

The Financial Times, citing informed sources, reported that a Blackstone fund plans to invest $9 billion in this deal. This capital will be used to invest in chip-related debt, which is supported by Anthropic's lease payments for using these chips over the next five years. 《金融时报》援引知情人士称，黑石旗下基金计划为这笔交易投入 90 亿美元。这笔资金将用于投资与芯片相关的债务，该债务以 Anthropic 未来五年为使用这些芯片而支付的租赁款项作为支持。

item.title: 智界拟取得独立造车资质，内部人士确认独立上市计划
item.guid: 智界拟取得独立造车资质，内部人士确认独立上市计划
item.description:
On October 17, an insider from Luxeed Auto confirmed to Yicai that the company will obtain independent car manufacturing qualifications after the relevant public announcement period ends and approval is granted; the insider also confirmed that Luxeed plans to go public independently in the future. 10 月 17 日，智界汽车内部人士向第一财经确认，公司在相关公示结束并获批后，将取得独立造车资质；该人士同时确认，智界未来计划独立上市。

The 412th batch of "Road Motor Vehicle Manufacturers and Products Announcement" publicized by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on October 16 has listed Anhui Luxeed New Energy Automobile Co., Ltd. in the "Newly Approved Vehicle Manufacturers to be Released" list, with the public announcement period ending on October 23. 工信部 10 月 16 日公示的第 412 批《道路机动车辆生产企业及产品公告》，已将安徽智界新能源汽车有限公司列入「拟发布新准入车辆生产企业」清单，公示期至 10 月 23 日。

The Luxeed production address in the announcement is precisely the Wuhu plant that Chery applied to deregister during the same period. An insider at Luxeed summarized this as "Chery's factory being given to Luxeed." This step involves the transfer of the production entity of an existing factory and is currently still in the public announcement and pending approval stage. 公示中的智界生产地址，正是奇瑞同期申请注销的芜湖厂区。智界内部人士将此概括为「奇瑞的工厂给到了智界」。这一步涉及现有工厂生产主体的转移，目前仍处于公示待批阶段。

Luxeed had previously operated independently with separate accounting within Chery. After the industrial and commercial changes at the end of June this year, Chery's shareholding decreased from 100% to 85%, with two equity investment partnerships each holding 7.5%. 智界此前已在奇瑞内部独立核算、自主经营。今年 6 月底的工商变更后，奇瑞持股由 100% 降至 85%，两家股权投资合伙企业各持 7.5%。

item.title: Tibo 回应 Codex 用户许愿：五项建议中有两项正在做
item.guid: Tibo-回应-Codex-用户许愿：五项建议中有两项正在做
item.description:
On October 17, Tibo Sottiaux, a member of OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT teams, responded to a user's wish list on X, stating that the team "is working on two of them." 10 月 17 日，OpenAI 的 Codex 与 ChatGPT 团队成员 Tibo Sottiaux 在 X 上回应一份用户许愿清单，称团队「正在做其中两项」。

This list was proposed by user AI Fun, specifically hoping for: 这份清单由用户 AI Fun 提出，具体希望：

    Remove the 5-hour usage limit for Plus;

    Open dot to Plus users;

    Increase ultrafast acceleration to 15x;

    Double the usage of Pro 20x;

    Increase the output speed of GPT-6.1 Sol to at least 50 tokens per second.

In a recent update, he also introduced how Codex and Work increase the actual available quota: by reusing context between sub-agents, extending context cache time, and improving cache hit rates through optimized request routing. 在近期更新中，他还介绍了 Codex 与 Work 提高实际可用额度的做法：在子智能体之间复用上下文、延长上下文缓存时间，并通过优化请求路由提高缓存命中率。

Another announced change is the addition of slide support to ChatGPT Space, initially available to Pro, Business, and Enterprise users. 另一项已公布的变化是 ChatGPT Space 增加幻灯片支持，先面向 Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 用户开放。

item.title: 长安董事长：国内车市承压，要全力聚焦海外
item.guid: 长安董事长：国内车市承压，要全力聚焦海外
item.description:
Zhao Fei, the new chairman of Changan Automobile, stated at a media briefing on October 16 that the domestic automotive market is experiencing a severe decline, but opportunities still exist overseas, and Changan will fully focus on international development. His assessment of domestic competition is: 长安汽车新任董事长赵非在 10 月 16 日的媒体沟通会上谈到，国内汽车市场下滑严重，海外仍有机会，长安要全力聚焦海外发展。他对国内竞争的判断是：

The domestic competitive landscape has, at times, already entered a stage of the Matthew effect and reshuffling.

He believes that the irrational behavior of some competitors will affect product pricing and the sustainable development of the market. 他认为，部分友商的非理性行为会影响产品定价和市场的可持续发展。

According to on-site reports from Yicai and Jiemian News, Zhao Fei believes that Changan has advantages in new energy and intelligent features compared to some overseas car manufacturers. However, the past approach of "selling well domestically, then selling globally" is no longer viable, as European user demands differ from domestic users, and there are also differences between Northern and Southern Europe. 据第一财经和界面新闻的现场报道，赵非认为，长安在新能源和智能化方面相对部分海外车企具备优势。但过去「国内卖得好，再卖到全球」的做法已经行不通，欧洲用户与国内用户的需求不同，北欧和南欧也有差异。

Addressing these differences, he proposed that product definition should start with global user needs and formulate a global blockbuster product strategy. According to Changan's plan, the global sales target for 2027 is over 3 million vehicles, with an overseas target of 1.5 million vehicles. He also emphasized "balancing volume and profit" and not participating in price wars. 针对这些差异，他提出，产品定义应以全球用户需求为起点，制定全球大单品策略。按照长安的规划，2027 年全球销量目标为 300 万辆以上，其中海外目标为 150 万辆。他同时强调「量利并重」，不参与价格战。

Regarding the European market, Zhao Fei stated that local partners are expected to be announced soon, and products will be launched in the first half of next year. Entering Europe requires adhering to long-term commitment, localization, and systematization, not "making a quick buck and leaving." Overseas markets, products, efficiency, and brand integration will be Changan's next four focus areas, with overseas markets being the top priority. 对于欧洲市场，赵非表示，当地合作伙伴预计很快公布，明年上半年将有产品落地。进入欧洲需要坚持长期化、本地化和体系化，不能「赚一把就跑」。海外、产品、效率和品牌整合将是长安接下来的四个聚焦方向，其中海外排在首位。

item.title: DeepSeek 更新模型，能按需求生成游戏和 3D 场景
item.guid: DeepSeek-更新模型，能按需求生成游戏和-3D-场景
item.description:
On October 17, DeepSeek upgraded V4.1 Flash to Flash-1017. The web, app, and API versions have been updated simultaneously, and the model's calling method and price remain unchanged. 10 月 17 日，DeepSeek 将 V4.1 Flash 升级至 Flash-1017，网页端、App 和 API 已同步更新，模型调用方式与价格不变。

The new version enhances the ability to develop games from scratch and build 3D scenes. The official team demonstrated Forbidden City 3D modeling, a web-based racing game, and a Godot-based replica of "Portal 2" using DeepSeek Harness. The model weights are open-sourced under the MIT license, and Harness has also been adapted. 新版增强了从零开发游戏、搭建 3D 场景的能力。官方用 DeepSeek Harness 演示了故宫 3D 建模、网页版赛车，以及基于 Godot 的《传送门 2》复刻。模型权重采用 MIT 许可开源，Harness 也已适配。

On the same day, DeepSeek opened its search and web scraping APIs, used for searching web pages and extracting web page content, respectively. Both interfaces are billed per successful request, at 5 yuan per 1000 requests. When using DeepSeek API via Harness, Claude Code, or Codex, search and scraping generated by server-side tool calls are currently free, but will be charged starting from November 1st at 00:00. DeepSeek 同日开放搜索与网页抓取 API，分别用于搜索网页、提取网页正文，两项接口均按成功请求计费，每 1000 次 5 元。通过 Harness、Claude Code 或 Codex 使用 DeepSeek API 时，服务端工具调用产生的搜索与抓取目前免费，11 月 1 日 00:00 起收费。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, DeepSeek released a new model! Using "wish-style programming" to refresh the kill line 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，DeepSeek 发布新模型！用「许愿式编程」刷新斩杀线

item.title: Meta 删除争议抓取条款，称未扩大 AI 训练权限
item.guid: Meta-删除争议抓取条款，称未扩大-AI-训练权限
item.description:
Meta has once again modified its commercial terms, removing a section that caused concern among news websites. The previous clause stated that Meta could use content from domains, web pages, or URLs associated with business accounts to provide, develop, improve, and train its products and services. Meta 再次修改商业条款，删除了一段引发新闻网站担忧的内容。此前的条文称，Meta 可使用商业账户关联域名、网页或 URL 的内容，来提供、开发、改进和训练旗下产品与服务。

According to The Verge, legal experts such as James Grimmelmann, a professor of digital and information law at Cornell University, believe that this wording could grant Meta permission to freely scrape news websites and train AI, potentially even overriding restrictions expressed by websites via robots.txt. 据 The Verge 报道，康奈尔大学数字与信息法教授 James Grimmelmann 等法律人士认为，这种表述可能让 Meta 获得免费抓取新闻网站、训练 AI 的权限，甚至覆盖网站通过 robots.txt 表达的限制。

Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts stated that the integrated scraping clause only applies to advertising and commercial products, and the company has clarified this in the terms. He emphasized that Meta's use of web crawlers has not changed, content owners can still express preferences via robots.txt, and this update does not grant Meta new rights to override these preferences. Meta 发言人 Daniel Roberts 则表示，被整合的抓取条款仅适用于广告和商业产品，公司已在条文中澄清这一点。他强调，Meta 使用网络爬虫的方式没有改变，内容所有者仍可通过 robots.txt 表达偏好，此次更新也没有赋予 Meta 凌驾于这些偏好之上的新权利。

item.title: TikTok 暂停纪录片《马斯克》广告账户，发行方正在申诉
item.guid: TikTok-暂停纪录片《马斯克》广告账户，发行方正在申诉
item.description:
According to an exclusive report by The Hollywood Reporter, TikTok has suspended the advertising account for the documentary "Musk," citing multiple instances of political content that violated platform policies. Distributor Bleecker Street confirmed receiving a "permanent suspension" notice and is currently appealing. 据《好莱坞报道》独家报道，TikTok 暂停了纪录片《Musk》的广告账户，理由是多次发布违反平台政策的政治内容。发行商 Bleecker Street 确认收到「永久暂停」通知，目前正在申诉。

This restriction targets paid advertisements and content boosting, while the film's regular TikTok account remains active. Emails reviewed by The Hollywood Reporter show that materials like trailers repeatedly cycled between rejection and appeal; TikTok had also previously blocked an ad quoting a film review, citing it as a static image. 这项限制针对付费广告和内容加热，影片的普通 TikTok 账号仍保持活跃。《好莱坞报道》查看的邮件显示，预告片等素材在拒登与申诉之间反复流转；TikTok 方面还曾以静态图片为由拦下一则引用影评的广告。

"Musk," directed by Alex Gibney, involved over three years of investigation into Musk's businesses, acquisition of Twitter, and political activities. The film is expanding to over 470 screens in North America, and the distributor expressed disappointment that the advertising restrictions occurred during the expansion weekend. TikTok did not comment on the report. 《Musk》由 Alex Gibney 执导，调查历时三年多，涉及马斯克的企业、收购 Twitter 及政治活动。影片正在北美扩映至 470 多块银幕，发行商对广告限制发生在扩映周末表示失望。TikTok 未就该报道发表评论。

item.title: Zeabur 宣布逐步停运，12 月 31 日前关闭全部服务器
item.guid: Zeabur-宣布逐步停运，12-月-31-日前关闭全部服务器
item.description:
Lin Yuan-lin, founder of cloud deployment platform Zeabur, announced in a user email that the platform will gradually cease operations, with some services stopping sequentially from December 1st, and all dedicated servers and shared clusters to be shut down by December 31st. 云部署平台 Zeabur 创始人林沅霖在用户邮件中宣布，平台将逐步结束运营，部分服务从 12 月 1 日起陆续停止，所有专用服务器与共享集群将在 12 月 31 日前关闭。

The specific arrangements are divided into two categories: dedicated servers will cease renewal from December 1st and will be shut down sequentially during the month according to their respective expiration dates; shared clusters will suspend running services from the same day, but users can still manually restore them for backup purposes. The platform has stopped new dedicated server and domain purchases and has begun processing account balance refunds, with domains also available for self-service transfer out. 具体安排分为两类：专用服务器从 12 月 1 日起停用续费，并按各自到期日在当月陆续关机；共享集群同日起暂停运行中的服务，用户仍可手动恢复，以便备份。平台已停止新的专用服务器与域名购买，并开始受理账户余额退款，域名也可自助转出。

Before this email was sent, Zeabur experienced successive security incidents in late August and October. The official status page confirmed that the second incident involved the platform's database being read, exposing content including service environment variables, account information, and API Tokens, with some Google Cloud dedicated servers also experiencing unauthorized access. Lin Yuan-lin stated that after being attacked again, the team re-evaluated the investment required for continued operation and the responsibilities it could bear, ultimately deciding to cease operations. 这封邮件发布前，Zeabur 在 8 月底和 10 月接连发生安全事件。官方状态页确认，第二次事件涉及平台数据库被读取，暴露内容包括服务环境变量、账户信息及 API Token，部分 Google Cloud 专用服务器也遭到未授权访问。林沅霖表示，再次遭到攻击后，团队重新评估了持续运营所需投入和能够承担的责任，最终决定停运。

The team will provide migration guides, as well as Markdown guides and Skills for use with Claude Code and Codex. December 31st is the date when all services will stop, and each service must still be backed up and migrated in advance according to its own expiration date. 团队将提供迁移指南，以及可供 Claude Code、Codex 使用的 Markdown 指南和 Skills。12 月 31 日是全部服务停止的日期，各项服务仍须按自身到期日提前备份和迁移。

item.title: Anthropic 拟拨出 5% 股份设公益基金，仍需股东批准
item.guid: Anthropic-拟拨出-5%-股份设公益基金，仍需股东批准
item.description:
Anthropic announced its intention to allocate 5% of the company's shares to the newly established Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a proposal that still requires shareholder approval. Subsequently, for every 50% increase in the company's value compared to a set baseline, the board may, at its discretion, add another 2% of shares, which is not an automatic allocation. Anthropic 宣布，拟将公司 5% 的股份划入新设的 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund，方案仍需股东批准。此后，公司价值每较设定基准增长 50%，董事会可酌情再增加 2% 的股份，并非自动划拨。

The fund will be established as a wholly-owned limited liability company of the company and can be used for donations to non-profit organizations, direct distribution of funds to specific groups, and addressing the impact of AI on the job market. Anthropic stated that it had previously committed $200 million to research and address employment impacts, and the new fund can support a wider range of actions. The company equity held by the fund will not be used for lobbying or political donations in the US or abroad. 基金将以公司全资持有的有限责任公司形式设立，可用于向非营利组织捐赠、向特定群体直接分配资金，以及应对 AI 对就业市场的冲击。Anthropic 称，此前已承诺投入 2 亿美元研究和应对就业影响，新基金可支持更大范围的行动。基金持有的公司股权不会用于美国或海外的游说和政治捐赠。

Together with previous donation commitments from founders and employees, approximately 20% of Anthropic's shares will be used for public benefit; this proportion may increase if future valuations reach certain thresholds. The company plans to announce details of the fund's governance, structure, and valuation thresholds in the coming months. 连同创始人和员工此前的捐赠承诺，约 20% 的 Anthropic 股份将被用于公共利益；未来估值达到特定门槛时，比例还可能增加。公司计划在未来数月公布基金治理、结构及估值门槛细节。

item.title: 迪士尼拟接收 Character.AI 逾 60 名员工，三年薪酬约 1.8 亿美元
item.guid: 迪士尼拟接收-Character.AI-逾-60-名员工，三年薪酬约-1.8-亿美元
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, citing bankruptcy court documents, Disney has agreed to hire over 60 Character.AI employees, covering most of the company's team, with total compensation of approximately $180 million over the first three years. Disney will also allocate an additional $30 million for subsequent retention bonuses, with some payments to be made on the first and second anniversaries of the deal's completion. 据彭博社援引破产法庭文件报道，迪士尼同意聘用 Character.AI 的 60 多名员工，覆盖该公司大部分团队，前三年的合计薪酬约为 1.8 亿美元。迪士尼还将另拨 3000 万美元用于后续留任奖励，其中部分款项会在交易完成一周年、两周年时支付。

This team arrangement is calculated separately from the asset acquisition price. Disney had previously offered to purchase some Character.AI assets for $20 million and had paid a portion of that before Character.AI filed for bankruptcy. Karandeep Anand, former CEO of Character.AI, has already joined Disney as the entertainment company's first CTO. 这笔团队安排与资产收购价分开计算。迪士尼此前提出以 2000 万美元购买 Character.AI 部分资产，并在后者申请破产前已支付其中一部分。Character.AI 前 CEO Karandeep Anand 则已先行加入迪士尼，出任这家娱乐公司的首位 CTO。

Character.AI filed for bankruptcy protection on October 12, facing high operating costs, lawsuits related to child safety, and government investigations. Disney's arrangement still requires approval from a bankruptcy judge; if higher bids emerge, a bankruptcy auction may be held in November, and employees can also interview with other companies. Character.AI 于 10 月 12 日申请破产保护，面临较高运营成本、与未成年人安全有关的诉讼和政府调查。迪士尼的安排仍需破产法官批准；若出现更高报价，11 月可能举行破产拍卖，员工也可与其他公司面谈。

🔗 Related Reading: The originator of AI companionship went bankrupt, you can export chat records, but you can't take TA with you 🔗 相关阅读： AI 陪伴鼻祖破产，你能导出聊天记录，却带不走 TA

item.title: 💡 孟樸：AI 将走向端云协同，智能体会主动调用应用和设备
item.guid: 💡-孟樸：AI-将走向端云协同，智能体会主动调用应用和设备
item.description:
According to Sina Technology, Meng Pu, Chairman of Qualcomm China, stated at the Northeast Asia (Shenyang) Talent Exchange Conference and AI Empowerment Industry Development Conference that AI will increasingly move towards cloud-edge collaboration, with a large number of tasks expanding to mobile phones, PCs, cars, robots, and industrial equipment, and terminal-side AI is playing an increasingly important role. 据新浪科技报道，高通中国区董事长孟樸在东北亚（沈阳）人才交流大会暨人工智能赋能产业发展大会上表示，AI 将越来越多地走向云端与边缘协同，大量任务正扩展到手机、PC、汽车、机器人和工业设备，终端侧 AI 正发挥更重要的作用。

The division of labor he proposed is: the cloud possesses powerful models and computing power, suitable for handling complex, resource-intensive tasks; the terminal has its own advantages in real-time response, reliability, and personalized experience. 他给出的分工是：云端拥有强大的模型与算力，适合处理复杂、资源密集型任务；终端在实时响应、可靠性和个性化体验方面有自身优势。

Intelligent agents will further accelerate this trend: after AI understands human intentions and the current scenario, it can actively invoke different applications, services, and devices to jointly complete tasks, thus gradually shifting the computing experience from application-centric to agent-centric. 智能体会进一步加速这一趋势：AI 理解人的意图和所处场景后，可以主动调用不同的应用、服务和设备，共同完成任务，计算体验因而逐步从以应用为中心转向以智能体为中心。

Regarding industrial implementation, Meng Pu emphasized the need to connect terminals, automobiles, manufacturing, developers, universities, and research institutions to facilitate collaboration among talent, technology, and industry. 在产业落地上，孟樸强调，应把终端、汽车、制造业、开发者、高校和科研机构连接起来，让人才、技术与产业协同。

item.title: 特斯拉高管详解 Roadster「飞行」原理：风扇吸地、氮气推进器助推
item.guid: 特斯拉高管详解-Roadster「飞行」原理：风扇吸地、氮气推进器助推
item.description:
How does the "flying" function of the Tesla Roadster work? In a live report published on October 16, a MotorTrend reporter documented Tesla's Head of Vehicle Engineering, Lars Moravy's technical explanation of the prototype: underbody fans are responsible for increasing grip, and compressed nitrogen thrusters provide additional thrust. 特斯拉 Roadster 的「飞行」功能如何实现？MotorTrend 记者在 10 月 16 日发布的现场报道中，记录了特斯拉车辆工程负责人 Lars Moravy 对原型车的技术讲解：车底风扇负责增加抓地力，另有压缩氮气推进器提供额外推力。

    Fan Suction : Four fans at the rear of the car draw air from beneath the chassis, creating a low-pressure area in conjunction with the lowered side skirts, generating downforce even when stationary. Active aerodynamic components also include a front wing, front hood, and large rear wing, with some actuators utilizing Optimus robot ankle joint technology.

    Nitrogen Boost : The Thrust version supplies four cold gas thrusters with 200 liters of high-pressure storage; the single-seat Rocket version further accommodates an additional 400-liter tank in the passenger seat space, increasing the total capacity to 600 liters and the thrusters to ten, used respectively for body lift, steering, and forward acceleration. They generate thrust by releasing compressed gas, without combustion.

    Power and Progress : The rear wheels are each driven by two motors, with a total power of 1 megawatt, and the battery uses 4680 cells. The reporter saw a prototype with production intent, and Tesla's production target is 2028, with actual performance and delivery arrangements still awaiting subsequent confirmation.

item.title: RTX Spark 笔记本正式开售，2599 美元起
item.guid: RTX-Spark-笔记本正式开售，2599-美元起
item.description:
Nvidia announced on October 16 that laptops equipped with RTX Spark are officially on sale, with global product prices starting at $2599, and specific configurations and prices varying by region. 英伟达 10 月 16 日宣布，搭载 RTX Spark 的笔记本电脑正式开售，全球产品起价为 2599 美元，具体配置与价格因地区而异。

The first lineup covers ASUS ProArt P14/P16, Dell XPS 16, HP OmniBook Ultra/OmniBook X 14, Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n, Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra, and MSI Prestige N16 series. 首批阵容覆盖华硕 ProArt P14／P16、戴尔 XPS 16、惠普 OmniBook Ultra／OmniBook X 14、联想 Yoga Pro 9n、微软 Surface Laptop Ultra，以及微星 Prestige N16 系列。

RTX Spark integrates a Grace CPU and Blackwell RTX GPU into a single superchip, equipped with up to 128GB of unified memory, and officially claims to provide up to 1 PFLOPS of FP4 AI computing power. Shared memory can be used for local models, AI agents, and large 3D scenes, with MediaTek participating in the design of the custom CPU. RTX Spark 将 Grace CPU 与 Blackwell RTX GPU 集成在同一颗超级芯片中，最高配备 128GB 统一内存，官方标称最高提供 1 PFLOPS 的 FP4 AI 算力。共享内存可用于本地模型、AI 智能体和大型 3D 场景，联发科参与了定制 CPU 的设计。

Software adaptation also arrives with the complete machine: native support for Photoshop and Premiere is first provided as a beta version; Windows on Arm gains PyTorch-CUDA builds, and Nvidia claims to support 97% of the 15,000 most popular Python packages. The launch game lineup includes "Cyberpunk 2077," "Fortnite," "Marvel Rivals," and "NBA 2K27," with compatible games able to use technologies such as DLSS, ray tracing, and Reflex. 软件适配也随整机到来：Photoshop 和 Premiere 的原生支持先以测试版提供；Windows on Arm 获得 PyTorch-CUDA 构建，英伟达称已支持最热门 1.5 万个 Python 包中的 97%。首发游戏阵容包括《赛博朋克 2077》《堡垒之夜》《漫威争锋》和《NBA 2K27》，兼容游戏可使用 DLSS、光线追踪及 Reflex 等技术。

🔗 Related Reading: Surface Laptop Ultra First Impressions: The Most Powerful Windows Laptop, and an All-Rounder for the AI Era 🔗 相关阅读： Surface Laptop Ultra 首发体验：是最强 Windows 笔记本，也是 AI 时代的全能本

item.title: 吉利星瑞 L PLUS 上市，限时 10.97 万元起
item.guid: 吉利星瑞-L-PLUS-上市，限时-10.97-万元起
item.description:
The Geely Xingrui L PLUS was launched on October 17, offering 4 1.5TD+DHT intelligent hybrid models and 4 2.0TD+8AT fuel models. The official guide price ranges from 119,700 to 153,700 yuan, and according to IT Home, the limited-time launch price is 109,700 to 143,700 yuan. 吉利星瑞 L PLUS 于 10 月 17 日上市，提供 4 款 1.5TD＋DHT 智擎混动车型和 4 款 2.0TD＋8AT 燃油车型。官方指导价为 11.97 万元至 15.37 万元，据 IT 之家报道，上市限时价为 10.97 万元至 14.37 万元。

The new car measures 4956×1915×1505mm (L×W×H) with a wheelbase of 2845mm. The hybrid version is equipped with an i-HEV system, featuring a 1.5TD engine with a maximum power of 120kW and a drive motor with a maximum power of 175kW, with an officially announced WLTC fuel consumption of 3.98 liters per 100 kilometers; the 2.0TD fuel version is paired with an 8AT transmission. 新车长宽高为 4956×1915×1505mm，轴距 2845mm。混动版本搭载 i-HEV 系统，1.5TD 发动机最大功率 120kW，驱动电机最大功率 175kW，官方公布的 WLTC 百公里油耗为 3.98 升；2.0TD 燃油版搭配 8AT 变速箱。

The top configurations of both powertrain lines offer the Qianli Haohan H5 assisted driving solution, with sensors including 1 lidar, 3 millimeter-wave radars, and 11 high-definition cameras, supporting urban and highway navigation assisted driving, memory parking, and other functions. 两条动力线的顶配均提供千里浩瀚 H5 辅助驾驶方案，传感器包含 1 颗激光雷达、3 颗毫米波雷达和 11 颗高清摄像头，支持城市及高速领航辅助驾驶、记忆泊车等功能。

The cockpit is equipped with Flyme Auto 2, a 15.4-inch 2.5K central control screen, and a 10.2-inch instrument cluster. Different versions offer configurations such as CCD variable damping suspension, seat ventilation, heating, and massage. 座舱配备 Flyme Auto 2、15.4 英寸 2.5K 中控屏和 10.2 英寸仪表，不同版本提供 CCD 可变阻尼悬架、座椅通风加热与按摩等配置。

item.title: 埃安 Ray7 开启预售，12.88 万元起
item.guid: 埃安-Ray7-开启预售，12.88-万元起
item.description:
On October 17, Aion's first mid-to-large pure electric sedan in the Ray series, the Ray7, began pre-sales, offering 5 configurations with pre-sale prices ranging from 128,800 to 158,800 yuan. 10 月 17 日，埃安 Ray 系列首款中大型纯电轿车 Ray7 开启预售，共推出 5 款配置，预售价为 12.88 万元至 15.88 万元。

The Ray7 features a rear-wheel-drive layout, with a length of 4960mm and a wheelbase of 2920mm, offering two CLTC range options of 530 km and 702 km. The new car is equipped with Huawei's DriveONE all-in-one electric drive, and the top-trim model also features an EMB full-by-wire braking system and iTrack intelligent torque control system. Ray7 采用后驱布局，车长 4960mm、轴距 2920mm，提供 530 公里和 702 公里两档 CLTC 续航。新车搭载华为 DriveONE 多合一电驱，顶配车型还配备 EMB 全电线控制动系统及 iTrack 智能扭矩控制系统。

For driving assistance, the laser version is equipped with a 192-line lidar and adopts WeRide's one-stage end-to-end large model. The cockpit is powered by a Snapdragon 8295P chip, featuring 24GB of RAM, 128GB of storage, and a 15.6-inch 2.5K central control screen. 驾驶辅助方面，激光版配备 192 线激光雷达，采用文远知行一段式端到端大模型。座舱搭载骁龙 8295P 芯片，配备 24GB 内存、128GB 存储及 15.6 英寸 2.5K 中控屏。

The chassis features a front double-wishbone and rear five-link suspension, equipped with FSD adaptive damping shock absorbers. The new car adopts AION's new brand identity and 'Quantum Star Ring' light cluster, offering 7 body colors. 底盘采用前双叉臂、后五连杆悬架，并配备 FSD 自适应阻尼减振器。新车换用埃安全新品牌标识与「量子星环」灯组，提供 7 种车身颜色。

item.title: AMG 首款独立研发纯电 SUV 发布，GT 63 零百加速 2.7 秒
item.guid: AMG-首款独立研发纯电-SUV-发布，GT-63-零百加速-2.7-秒
item.description:
Mercedes-AMG has released the GT SUV, the brand's first full-size SUV independently developed from scratch, and the second model based on the AMG.EA pure electric architecture. The new car offers three versions: GT 53, GT 55, and GT 63. The GT 53 has a suggested retail price starting from 113,050 Euros in Germany (including tax), with orders opening on October 20th; the other two models are planned for release in spring 2027. 梅赛德斯-AMG 发布 GT SUV，这是品牌首款从零开始独立研发的全尺寸 SUV，也是 AMG.EA 纯电架构的第二款车型。新车提供 GT 53、GT 55 和 GT 63 三个版本，GT 53 德国含税建议零售价 113050 欧元起，10 月 20 日开放订购；另外两款计划于 2027 年春季推出。

    GT 53: Dual motors, maximum power 400kW, equipped with a 106kWh battery.

    GT 55: Three axial flux motors, maximum power 600kW.

    GT 63: Three axial flux motors, maximum power 860kW, peak torque 2000N·m, conventional 0–100km/h acceleration in 2.7 seconds; 2.5 seconds using a one-foot rollout start.

High-end models offer a 128kWh battery, with an officially announced WLTP range of up to 700 kilometers and a maximum DC fast charging power of 710kW. According to preliminary manufacturer test conditions, a 10-minute charge can add approximately 450 kilometers of WLTP range. The vehicle also features rear-wheel steering, active hydraulic roll control, and delivers the AMG sound experience through real engine recordings, simulated gear shifts, and seat vibrations. 高配车型提供 128kWh 电池，官方公布的 WLTP 续航最高 700 公里，直流快充功率最高 710kW。按厂商初步测试条件，充电 10 分钟可增加约 450 公里 WLTP 续航。车辆还配有后轮转向、主动液压侧倾控制，并通过真实发动机录音、模拟换挡及座椅振动呈现 AMG 声浪体验。

item.title: Reason Network 更新独立运行模式，让不同电脑上的 AI 编程助手直接通信
item.guid: Reason-Network-更新独立运行模式，让不同电脑上的-AI-编程助手直接通信
item.description:
Reason has updated its open-source project Reason Network. Version 0.10.4, released on October 17th, adds a standalone usage mode that doesn't require a Reason account and supports migration for existing tincan users. It connects AI programming assistants on different team members' computers, allowing one session to directly query another without manual rephrasing. Reason 更新了开源项目 Reason Network，10 月 17 日发布的 0.10.4 版加入无需 Reason 账户的独立使用方式，并支持原 tincan 用户迁移。它把团队成员不同电脑上的 AI 编程助手连在一起，让一个会话可以直接询问另一个会话，无须人工反复转述。

Each computer runs a lightweight background program. The team directory shows whose Agent is online, which repository and branch they are working on, whether they are busy or idle, and their current task. Supported platforms include Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, and OpenCode; among them, Claude Code and Codex can receive messages within existing sessions. 每台电脑运行一个轻量后台程序，团队通讯录会显示谁的 Agent 在线、正在处理哪个仓库和分支、处于忙碌还是空闲状态，以及当前任务。支持范围包括 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot CLI 和 OpenCode；其中 Claude Code、Codex 可以在现有会话里接收消息。

Computers prioritize peer-to-peer communication, connecting within the same LAN or across the internet. If a direct connection fails, messages are relayed through a relay that can only see encrypted data. The project uses the MIT or Apache 2.0 license. 电脑之间优先点对点通信，同一局域网或跨互联网均可连接；直连失败时，经只能看到加密数据的中继传递消息。项目采用 MIT 或 Apache 2.0 许可证。

The feature to automatically detect multiple Agents modifying the same file simultaneously is still on the future development roadmap. Currently, it provides work status sharing and session communication, but cannot automatically prevent code overwrites. 自动检测多名 Agent 同时修改同一文件的功能仍在后续开发清单中。现阶段提供的是工作状态共享和会话通信，不能自动阻止代码覆盖。

item.title: VAST 开源 EdenLive，称单张 RTX 5090 可实时生成 720P 画面
item.guid: VAST-开源-EdenLive，称单张-RTX-5090-可实时生成-720P-画面
item.description:
VAST has released and open-sourced the code and 5B, 14B model weights for its real-time generative rendering model, EdenLive. The team announced that the 5B model can generate 720P visuals at over 24FPS on a single RTX 5090, supporting continuous generation for minutes. VAST 发布并开放实时生成式渲染模型 EdenLive 的代码与 5B、14B 模型权重。团队公布，5B 模型在单张 RTX 5090 上可生成 720P 画面，速度超过 24FPS，并支持分钟级连续生成。

EdenLive receives simplified scenes or reference videos, a target first frame, and text prompts: the reference footage determines layout, camera, and motion; the first frame and prompt control appearance and art style. Game rules, character positions, and interaction states are maintained by upstream programs or engines, while the model is responsible for rendering the reference footage into more refined visual content. Official demonstrations include game walkthroughs, video style transfer, and embodied operation video enhancement. EdenLive 接收简化场景或参考视频、目标首帧和文字提示：参考画面确定布局、镜头与运动，首帧与提示词控制外观和画风。游戏规则、角色位置和交互状态由上游程序或引擎维护，模型负责把参考画面渲染成更精细的视觉内容。官方展示了游戏漫游、视频换风格和具身操作视频增强等用法。

The accompanying Game Prototype Turbo can generate playable prototypes from prompts, which are then integrated into the rendering pipeline. Licensing is component-based: the main video model uses Apache 2.0, the visual encoder follows DINOv3 licensing; the FLUX component used for generating realistic first frames in the workbench is limited to non-commercial, non-production use, and the video generation pipeline itself does not depend on this component. 配套的 Game Prototype Turbo 可从提示词生成可玩原型，再接入渲染链路。授权按组件区分：主要视频模型采用 Apache 2.0，视觉编码器沿用 DINOv3 授权；工作台用于生成写实首帧的 FLUX 组件限非商业、非生产用途，视频生成管线本身不依赖该组件。

item.title: 苹果据称筹备机械臂版 HomeView，可转向说话者
item.guid: 苹果据称筹备机械臂版-HomeView，可转向说话者
item.description:
Apple is planning a high-end HomeView equipped with an electric robotic arm. According to a Power On report by Mark Gurman, cited by 9to5Mac, this device, codenamed J595, is targeted for release in 2027 or 2028. 苹果正在规划配备电动机械臂的高端 HomeView。据 9to5Mac 引述 Mark Gurman 的 Power On 报道，这款代号 J595 的设备目标是在 2027 年或 2028 年推出。

The report describes its screen as approximately 9 inches, larger than the current HomeView's 7 inches; the robotic arm allows the display to rotate 360 degrees. The device plans to use voice recognition to determine who is speaking and then automatically turn the screen towards that person, for use by people sitting in different positions. 报道描述，它的屏幕约为 9 英寸，大于当前 HomeView 的 7 英寸；机械臂可让显示屏旋转 360 度。设备计划利用语音识别判断谁在说话，再自动将屏幕转向那个人，供围坐在不同位置的人使用。

This version is positioned above the existing HomeView, rather than replacing the current model. The robotic arm, speaker recognition, and automatic turning are all part of the R&D plan, and related features and launch windows have not yet been officially announced by Apple. 这一版本定位高于现有 HomeView，而非替代当前机型。机械臂、识别说话者与自动转向均属于研发计划，相关功能和上市窗口尚未由苹果正式公布。

item.title: Swisse 两批次产品铅超标被召回，品牌称未进入中国市场
item.guid: Swisse-两批次产品铅超标被召回，品牌称未进入中国市场
item.description:
On October 17th, the Import and Export Food Safety Bureau of the General Administration of Customs issued a risk alert. The Australian Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) reported that two batches of Swisse 'Beauty Skin Regeneration+' products were found to have lead content exceeding standard limits, and the company will recall the relevant products. 海关总署进出口食品安全局 10 月 17 日发布风险警示，澳大利亚药品管理局通报，两批次 Swisse「Beauty Skin Regeneration+」产品被检出铅含量超出标准限值，企业将召回相关产品。

The product number listed in the notice is 01-141-20602, with batch numbers 144520 and 143217, and an expiry date of July 2028. Currently, no affected products have been found to be imported into China through general trade channels. Customs reminds consumers to check any products they may possess through cross-border e-commerce, personal carriage, or daigou (personal shopping) channels, immediately stop using the affected batches, and pay attention to further information from the Australian side. 通告列出的产品编号为 01-141-20602，批号分别为 144520、143217，有效期至 2028 年 7 月。目前，国内暂未发现涉事产品通过一般贸易渠道进口。海关提醒消费者核对通过跨境电商、携带、代购等渠道可能持有的产品，立即停止使用涉事批次，并关注澳方后续信息。

According to Southern Metropolis Daily, Swisse responded on October 18th, stating that the Australian company discovered issues during routine self-inspection and has voluntarily recalled the relevant batches. The brand stated that the affected batches only existed in Australia, have been recalled at controllable stages locally, have not flowed to consumers, and have never entered the Chinese market. 据南方都市报报道，Swisse 于 10 月 18 日回应称，澳洲公司在例行自检中发现问题，已主动召回相关批次。品牌方表示，涉事批次仅存在于澳洲，已在当地可控环节召回，未流入消费者端，也从未进入中国市场。

Customs risk warnings target specific products and batches, while the brand's response involves its verification of flow and recall status. Consumers need to match product numbers, batch numbers, and expiration dates when checking. 海关的风险警示针对具体产品与批次，品牌方上述回应则涉及其对流向和召回情况的核查。消费者核对时需对应产品编号、批号及有效期。

item.title: 刘德华、杨子姗主演《白衣逆行者》定档 11 月 6 日
item.guid: 刘德华、杨子姗主演《白衣逆行者》定档-11-月-6-日
item.description:
The film "The White-Clad Resisters" announced its release on November 6th and unveiled a "76 Days and Nights" version of its release trailer. The film is directed by Herman Yau, starring Andy Lau and Yang Zishan, with Qin Hailu, Yu Ailei, Han Tongsheng, and others participating. 电影《白衣逆行者》宣布于 11 月 6 日上映，并发布「76 个日夜」版定档预告。影片由邱礼涛执导，刘德华、杨子姗领衔主演，秦海璐、余皑磊、韩童生等参演。

The story goes back to early 2020, when university professor Shen Jun (played by Andy Lau) and doctor Yuan Chuchu (played by Yang Zishan), a married couple, rushed to Wuhan to treat patients together with local medical staff including head nurse Tian Lu (played by Qin Hailu) and doctor Zhong Lingyun (played by Yu Ailei), showcasing mutual assistance during this period through ordinary people from different professions. 故事回到 2020 年初，大学教授沈君（刘德华饰）与医生袁楚楚（杨子姗饰）夫妇赶赴武汉，与护士长田璐（秦海璐饰）、医生钟凌云（余皑磊饰）等当地医护人员共同救治病患，通过不同职业的普通人展现这段时期的守望相助。

item.title: 《Imperium》获伦敦电影节最佳影片
item.guid: 《Imperium》获伦敦电影节最佳影片
item.description:
The 70th BFI London Film Festival announced its competition unit awards on October 18th local time. Sergei Loznitsa's "Imperium" won Best Film. This work revisits the Soviet Union in the early 1970s using archival footage shot by Italian photographers. 第 70 届 BFI 伦敦电影节于当地时间 10 月 18 日公布竞赛单元奖项。谢尔盖·洛兹尼察执导的《Imperium》获得最佳影片，这部作品利用意大利摄影师拍摄的档案影像，重访 20 世纪 70 年代初的苏联。

Thai director Sompot Chidgasornpongse's debut feature film "9 Temples to Heaven" won the Sutherland Award for Best First Feature. The story revolves around a one-day pilgrimage: after hearing a prophecy that his mother might soon die, the protagonist tries to resolve the crisis by visiting nine temples. Apichatpong Weerasethakul participated in the production. 泰国导演 Sompot Chidgasornpongse 的首部长篇剧情片《9 Temples to Heaven》获得萨瑟兰最佳处女作奖。故事围绕一场一日朝圣展开：主人公听到母亲可能即将去世的预言后，试图通过走访九座寺庙化解危机。阿彼察邦·韦拉斯哈古参与制片。

Asmahan Bkerat's "Concrete Land" won the Grierson Award for Best Documentary, focusing on the life of a Jordanian family facing displacement and hostility. Audience Award voting will close on October 21st, with results to be announced separately. Asmahan Bkerat 执导的《Concrete Land》获得格里尔森最佳纪录片奖，镜头聚焦约旦一个家庭面对迁离与敌意时的生活。观众奖投票将于 10 月 21 日结束，结果另行公布。

item.title: Netflix 首次公布院线票房，《La Bola Negra》四馆收入 27.75 万美元
item.guid: Netflix-首次公布院线票房，《La-Bola-Negra》四馆收入-27.75-万美元
item.description:
According to Variety, Netflix has for the first time publicly released the theatrical box office figures for its films. "La Bola Negra," directed by Spanish filmmakers Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi, grossed $277,500 in four theaters, averaging approximately $69,400 per theater, setting a new record for the highest per-screen average for a Spanish-language film's opening. 据 Variety 报道，Netflix 首次对外公布旗下电影的院线票房。由西班牙导演 Javier Calvo 与 Javier Ambrossi 执导的《La Bola Negra》在四家影院收获 27.75 万美元，平均每家约 6.94 万美元，创下西班牙语电影开画馆均票房纪录。

The film revolves around the interconnected stories of three men across generations, and previously won the Best Director Award at Cannes and the Audience Choice Award at the Toronto Film Festival. Netflix plans to release it in theaters for 45 days, then launch it on the platform on December 2nd. This is the company's longest theatrical release window to date. 影片围绕三名男性跨越世代、彼此关联的故事展开，曾获戛纳最佳导演奖及多伦多电影节观众选择奖。Netflix 计划让它在影院放映 45 天，再于 12 月 2 日上线平台。这也是该公司迄今最长的院线发行窗口。

Netflix has previously released films like "Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery" briefly in theaters but did not disclose box office figures. Variety states that the company also plans to disclose the theatrical performance of future works, including David Fincher's "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth" and 2027's "Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew". Netflix 过去曾让《利刃出鞘 2》等电影短暂进入影院，但没有公布票房。Variety 称，公司今后也计划披露大卫·芬奇执导的《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》，以及 2027 年的《Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew》等作品的院线成绩。
